name: GNI Group Ltd.
summary: GNI Group Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of pharmaceuticals and biomaterials in Japan, China, and the United States. It operates in two segments, Pharmaceutical Business and Medical Equipment Business. The company offers ETUARY for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; H-GENIN Crush-Mix for the treatment of bone defects; AltiPly for the treatment of acute and chronic wounds; and orthobiologics products.
